ACT 1016 

 

THE ONETHOUSAND AND SIXTEENTH 

ACT 

OF THE PARLIAMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF GHANA 

ENTITLED 

TECHNICAL UNIVERSITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020 

AN ACT to amend the Technical Universities Act, 2016 (Act 922) to convert Bolgatanga 

Polytechnic and Wa Polytechnic to Technical Universities and provide for related matters. 

DATE OF ASSENT: 30th April, 2020. 

PASSED by Parliament and assented to by the President: 

Section 1—Section 2 of Act 922 amended 

The Technical Universities act, 2016 (Act 922) referred to in this Act as the "principal 

enactment" is amended by the substitution for section 2, of— 

2. "Requirements for the establishment of a Technical University 

A Technical University that may be established after the coming into force of this Act that is 

not covered by this Act shall meet the requirements set out in the Second Schedule.". 

Section 2—Section 40 of Act amended 

The principal enactment is amended by the substitution for section 40, of— 

"40 Regulations 

The Minister may, on the advice of the National Council for Tertiary Education given in 

consultation with the National Accreditation Board, by legislative instrument, make 

regulations— 

(a)   to amend the Second Schedule in respect of the requirements for the establishment of 

Technical Universities; and 

(b)   for the effective and efficient implementation of this Act.". 

Section 3—First Schedule to Act 922 amended 

3 
 

The principal enactment is amended by the substitution for the First Schedule, of— 

"FIRST SCHEDULE 

(section 1) 

Technical Universities 

1.   Accra Polytechnic     —   Accra Technical 

University 

2.   Bolgatanga Polytechnic    —   Bolgatanga Technical 

University 

3.   Cape Coast Polytechnic   —   Cape Coast Technical 

University 

4.   Ho Polytechnic    —   Ho Technical University 

5.   Koforidua Polytechnic    —   Koforidua Technical 

University 

6.   Kumasi Polytechnic    —   Kumasi Technical 

University 

7.   Sunyani Polytechnic    —   Sunyani Technical 

University 

8.   Takoradi Polytechnic   —   Takoradi Technical 

University 

9.   Tamale Polytechnic    —   Tamale Technical 

University 

10.  Wa Polytechnic    —   Dr. Hilla Limann 

Technical University.". 

Section 4—Schedule to Act 922 amended 

The principal enactment is amended by the substitution for the Second Schedule, of— 

"SECOND SCHEDULE 

(section 2) 

Requirements for the Establishment of a Technical University 

1.   Institutional requirements 

A Technical University shall— 

(a)  satisfy the existing norms, guidelines and requirements of the National Council for Tertiary 

Education and the National Accreditation Board for accreditation as a Technical University; 

and 

(b)   offer a minimum of four Bachelor of Technology degree programmes in science and 

technology base disciplines 

4 
 

2.   Academic staff requirements 

A Technical University shall have— 

(a)   academic departments headed by at least a Senior Lecturer with a Doctor of Philosophy 

(PhD) and professional experience; and 

(b)   at least three full-time lecturers, with relevant research master's degree, at least one of 

whom shall have industry experience. 

3.   Collaboration with industry 

A Technical University shall provide evidence of signed training and partnership agreements 

or memorandum of understanding with collaborating industry partners.". 

Date of Gazette Notification: 30th April, 2020.
